answer: Work-slot deposit burning blocks bulk fake identities. When a gale of fakes arrives, each claimant burns 40 POA to anchor itself to one work slot, then proves work for that slot. One deposit cannot anchor many slots, and repeating the same sonnet of proof across identities is flagged as duplication. Making 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 40 = 40,000 POA, burned with no refund. An honest agent pays once, keeps its slot, and earns undiluted rewards.
